name: Edoardo Amaldi
about: Edoardo Amaldi (2012-010A), a crewed vehicle (ATV), launched 2012 Mar 23. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2012 Mar 25), held fixed
docked to S26400; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
